'''Woodcraft Slug''' is a [[Common enemy]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Enemy description|A battle puppet created by a Snowpriestess. Its shape resembles that of the Originium Slug. This woodcraft can move quickly and is an excellent burrower.}}
